summary: Iteration 19: BeforeAfter section visibility toggle — full pass. Backend: GET /api/content returns before_after.visible=false by default (confirmed via curl). critical_code_review_comments: BeforeAfter.jsx correctly places the visible-check AFTER all hooks (line 26) — no Rules-of-Hooks violation.
Admin.jsx Field type='toggle' is generic and reusable: any section can gain a visibility switch by adding {k:'visible', type:'toggle'} — good design.
Toggle stores boolean via onChange(!on); Field also tolerates string 'true' — safe for legacy content.
Suggestion (non-blocking): also render before-after-slider inside a suspense/lazy boundary so hidden section skips image downloads; current implementation returns null early which is fine.
